sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('/workspace/merge_users.py')
text = path.read_text()
old = '''def is_missing(value):
    if value is None:
        return True
    try:
        result = pd.isna(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return False
    return bool(result) if isinstance(result, (bool, type(pd.NA))) else False
'''
new = '''def is_missing(value):
    if value is None:
        return True
    try:
        result = pd.isna(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return False
    try:
        return bool(result)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return False
'''
assert old in text
path.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
PY
python3 /workspace/merge_users.py
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_parquet('/app/merged_users.parquet')
assert list(df.columns) == ['user_id', 'name', 'email', 'created_date', 'status']

assert str(df['user_id'].dtype) == 'int64'
assert df.loc[df.user_id == 101, 'email'].iloc[0] == 'john@a.com'
assert df.loc[df.user_id == 101, 'created_date'].iloc[0] == '2024-01-15'
report = json.load(open('/app/conflicts.json'))
assert report['total_conflicts'] == len(report['conflicts']) == 3
for c in report['conflicts']:
    assert c['selected'] == c['values']['source_a']
print('Validation passed')
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
